=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:71 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The ambiguous-dispatch handling waits on the first candidate alone before entering the read-result stage that examines all candidates.
  WHY: `check_in_status.py:777` accepts a single run id, and `check_run` at `check_in_status.py:664-670` reports completion for that run only; the read-result stage is reached after the first candidate completes, so another project's queued candidate can delay reading this project's completed run. `dispatch_workflow.py:112` sorts run IDs descending, and the dispatching stage records that first candidate as its wait target; the read-result routing at line 246-256 checks other candidates only after that target completes. The reviewer notes that AD-6 records the wait-on-first-candidate trade-off and characterizes this as a design gap, not a regression.
- CLAUDE.md:1361 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The helper table undercounts API calls when `--ref` is omitted and inaccurately describes the polling-path reads.
  WHY: `dispatch_workflow.py:212` reads the default branch, `dispatch_workflow.py:218-223` attempts the pre-dispatch recent-run read, and `dispatch_workflow.py:237` reads the named run; this is 3 reads + 1 POST when `--ref` is omitted and 2 reads + 1 POST when supplied. On the polling path, the pre-dispatch read remains, so polling replaces the post-dispatch named-run read rather than the pre-dispatch read; the reviewer says the common stage invocation omits `--ref`.

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
